import.title: Import a question bank
import.note: Markdown and JSON both work. For Markdown use `## Question` plus the body, or `**Question**`, or `Q: Question`. A `> 方向: backend`, `> 主题: JVM`, `> 难度: 2` header sets defaults for the whole file, and `[难度:3]` on a heading overrides it. You can paste a whole repository's solutions straight in.
import.categoryFromFile: Read from the file header (> 方向:)
import.placeholder: Paste a Markdown or JSON question bank here…
import.customCount: {n} imported questions — they join the built-in bank in search and review

error.empty: Nothing to import — paste a question bank first
error.badShape: Unrecognised JSON shape — expected an array, or an object with a questions / items array
error.noQuestion: No questions found. Markdown needs a `## Question` heading, or a `**Question**` / `Q: Question` line.
error.noCategory: No track given: add `> 方向: backend` to the file header (backend / algo / system / frontend), or pick a default track above.

about.title: Bank and progress
about.note: The bank is fully offline and progress stays on this machine. Sources are the authoritative open-source references for the same topic, labelled with their star counts; the built-in answers are written for this tool rather than copied from those repositories.
